description: On the tabletop in front of the hands, there’s a white round base with a central socket and a separate white cross-shaped peg piece. The right hand reaches in from the right to pick up the cross-shaped piece, brings it over the round base, and lowers its stem into the center opening while the left hand moves in to steady and guide the fit, making the cross piece a two-hand object as it is aligned and pressed into place.
